propositions: The bridge noun must be established as a provider-neutral command group with preview and sync subcommands, neither breaking legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, rebar doctor) nor advertising unimplemented verbs before their stories land.
bridge preview must perform read-only operations using the existing dry-run engine path with no Jira or ticket-store mutations.
bridge sync must perform mutating operations using the existing live engine path.
Mode enum, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode reconcile-check compatibility must remain intact and unbroken across the refactor.
Nested subcommand dispatch must prevent sibling verbs from falling through to top-level commands and must not accept --mode or --filter-local-ids overrides at the bridge foundation level.

Documentation (user guide, CLI reference, release notes) must describe only the staged surface (preview and sync) while preserving all legacy command visibility and ensuring no placeholder or unimplemented verb is advertised.
